build.title: IncebtIon
build.ps2build_version:
ps2build v2026.10.15
Third-party licenses: see licenses/ in the source repository (git.techwritescode.dev/ps2/ps2build).

scope: Authentic menu rendering and navigation with nonbootable sample files. No gameplay or physical-console acceptance. No BIOS, memory cards or disc images included. Both editions use the same sample library, artwork and configuration.
config: Auto NTSC; wide_screen=1 and emulator 16:9 for library/per-game/Info (796x448 PNG); wide_screen=0 and emulator 4:3 for settings (640x480 PNG). Other lab choices are not recommended defaults.
processing: PNG frames unmodified. Library MP4 joins six seconds from each of four actual view takes (24 seconds, 960x540 20fps). Info MP4 first 30 seconds at 960x540 20fps; GIF first 20 seconds at 640x360 6fps/128 colors. Settings MP4 complete take, 640x480 20fps; GIF 480x360 5fps/64 colors. Library GIF 640x360 8fps/128 colors. Silent web delivery scaling does not add native UI detail.
